description.en: Speaks the Claude family over Bedrock's runtime API. AWS Bedrock Claude via the native Messages-shaped invoke API: SigV4-signed requests, eventstream rendered as Anthropic SSE, and the foundation-model catalog.
description.zh: 通过 Bedrock 运行时 API 接入 Claude 系列模型。 AWS Bedrock Claude：原生 Messages 形状的 invoke API，SigV4 签名请求，eventstream 转译为 Anthropic SSE，附基础模型目录。

description.en: Static IAM credentials for the Bedrock runtime. The region decides the upstream host.
description.zh: Bedrock 运行时的静态 IAM 凭证，region 决定上游站点。

help_text.en: Bedrock region hosting the models, e.g. us-east-1, eu-central-1, ap-northeast-1.
help_text.zh: 模型所在的 Bedrock 区域，如 us-east-1、eu-central-1、ap-northeast-1。

help_text.en: Only for temporary credentials from STS.
help_text.zh: 仅用于 STS 签发的临时凭证。

title.zh: 添加 AWS Bedrock 账号
